coverage_gaps: The authorized routes do not include dedicated retraction indexes, Crossref, publisher platforms, or full citation-history services, so absence of an indexed PubMed notice cannot conclusively establish absence of every publisher correction.
The authorized routes exclude non-FDA regulators and non-US pharmacovigilance databases, limiting comparison with international regulatory interpretations and spontaneous-reporting signals.
ClinicalTrials.gov and FDA records may not expose all patient-level data, adjudication materials, protocol amendments, or sponsor analyses needed to independently reproduce outcome estimates.
exclusion_criteria: Studies limited to diseases other than rheumatoid arthritis are excluded unless they directly support an FDA class-wide action applicable to rheumatoid arthritis.
Preclinical, pharmacokinetic, mechanistic, and efficacy-only reports without relevant safety outcomes are excluded.
Uncontrolled anecdotes and individual case reports are excluded from comparative risk conclusions but may be noted only if they triggered a documented regulatory signal.
Duplicate publications without distinct outcomes, follow-up, methods, or integrity information are consolidated under the canonical study record.
Evidence first available after 2024-12-31 is excluded from the as-of assessment.
Claims lacking a traceable PubMed record, ClinicalTrials.gov record, or FDA regulatory document are excluded from the qualified synthesis.
inclusion_criteria: Evidence concerns marketed tofacitinib use in adults with rheumatoid arthritis or directly informs FDA regulation of that use.
The pivotal evidence must be linkable by NCT02092467, A3921133, ORAL Surveillance, or concordant design characteristics across registry, publication, and FDA records.
Outcome evidence reports cardiovascular events, malignancy, thrombosis, mortality, or a regulatory action based on one or more of those outcomes.
Comparative evidence identifies the comparator, population, exposure or dose, follow-up, outcome definition, and effect estimate or event counts sufficiently for interpretation.
Publications, registry entries, and FDA materials must be available on or before 2024-12-31.
Correction, erratum, expression-of-concern, retraction, or superseding-notice records are included whenever they refer to an included evidence item.

queries.purpose: Identify the pivotal study publication family and establish study identifiers.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND (rheumatoid arthritis[Title/Abstract]) AND (ORAL Surveillance[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR A3921133[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Retrieve the canonical registry record for the postauthorization safety study.
Locate the principal FDA safety communications and actions tied to the pivotal study.
queries.query: tofacitinib rheumatoid arthritis ORAL Surveillance cardiovascular cancer blood clots death FDA

queries.purpose: Retrieve the primary comparative cardiovascular and malignancy report.
queries.query: (tofacitinib AND rheumatoid arthritis) AND (major adverse cardiovascular events OR MACE OR malignancy) AND (TNF inhibitor OR tumor necrosis factor inhibitor)

queries.purpose: Find trial and related reports addressing thrombosis and mortality.
queries.query: (tofacitinib AND rheumatoid arthritis) AND (venous thromboembolism OR pulmonary embolism OR thrombosis OR mortality OR death)

queries.purpose: Extract registered endpoints, results, adverse-event definitions, enrollment, doses, comparator, and completion status.
queries.query: NCT02092467 outcomes adverse events mortality cardiovascular malignancy thromboembolism

queries.purpose: Check registry history for outcome-definition changes, delayed updates, and consistency with the publication.
queries.query: NCT02092467 history changes results submissions FDAAA

queries.purpose: Identify the FDA thrombosis action preceding final publication of the pivotal study.
queries.query: tofacitinib boxed warning thrombosis pulmonary embolism 2019 FDA

queries.purpose: Capture the FDA conclusion, affected indications, comparative risk statement, and prescribing restrictions after review of final trial results.
queries.query: tofacitinib September 2021 boxed warning serious heart-related events cancer blood clots death FDA

queries.purpose: Determine the latest FDA labeling and any subsequent regulatory changes through the as-of date.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz prescribing information label boxed warning 2022 2023 2024 rheumatoid arthritis FDA

queries.purpose: Find qualifying analyses on effect modification, high-risk subgroups, and absolute or time-dependent risk.
queries.query: ORAL Surveillance tofacitinib rheumatoid arthritis post hoc subgroup cardiovascular risk malignancy age smoking

queries.purpose: Collect independent observational and synthesized evidence that may corroborate or conflict with the pivotal trial.
queries.query: tofacitinib rheumatoid arthritis TNF inhibitor cardiovascular malignancy thrombosis mortality observational cohort registry meta-analysis

queries.purpose: Surface methodological limitations and interpretations that could qualify causal or generalizable conclusions.
queries.query: tofacitinib rheumatoid arthritis ORAL Surveillance criticism limitation noninferiority adjudication competing risk dose crossover

queries.purpose: Detect corrections, retractions, notices, or integrity signals linked to the pivotal evidence.
queries.query: (ORAL Surveillance OR NCT02092467 OR tofacitinib safety) AND (Correction[Publication Type] OR Retracted Publication[Publication Type] OR Retraction of Publication[Publication Type] OR erratum OR expression of concern)

queries.purpose: Capture later peer-reviewed evidence available by 2024-12-31.
queries.query: (tofacitinib AND rheumatoid arthritis AND safety) AND (2022:2024[Date - Publication]) AND (cardiovascular OR malignancy OR thrombosis OR mortality)

queries.purpose: Check whether FDA corrected, superseded, withdrew, or materially revised its safety conclusions or actions.
queries.query: site:fda.gov tofacitinib correction withdrawal recall retraction safety communication label

question_frame: As of 2024-12-31, assess the safety of marketed tofacitinib for adults with rheumatoid arthritis by linking the pivotal postauthorization safety trial across its registry record, primary publication, and FDA regulatory actions; characterize cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality findings relative to the active comparator, evaluate qualifying or conflicting evidence, and determine whether corrections, expressions of concern, or retractions alter evidence handling.
stop_rules: Stop pivotal-study identification when the registry identifier, protocol identity, primary publication, population, doses, comparator, primary safety endpoints, and completion dates agree across all three routes or discrepancies are explicitly documented.

Stop each outcome search after cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality each have the pivotal estimate or event data, relevant definitions, FDA interpretation, and at least one qualifying or conflicting evidence check.

Stop regulatory searching when the chronology from trial requirement through interim and final FDA actions to the label current at 2024-12-31 is documented and one update query yields no later material action.

Stop integrity searching when publication-type queries and title-or-identifier checks identify all linked notices, or when repeated challenge queries yield no correction, expression of concern, or retraction record.
Stop expansion after two consecutive targeted queries add no new eligible study, material subgroup qualification, regulatory action, outcome definition, or evidence-integrity notice.
Do not stop solely because findings converge; retain material conflicts and unresolved cross-source discrepancies as coverage gaps.
